eventName: 6th Annual One Lakh Palm Seeds Plantation Festival
eventDescription:
The Vidhaigal Voluntary Organization, in association with Golden Hearts Lions Club, proudly inaugurated the 6th Annual One Lakh Palm Seeds Plantation Festival today at Kaliyanoor Lake in Kanchipuram District.
Participating institutions included:
? Triveni Academy
? St. Mary's College of Allied Health Sciences
? SRM College
? Sairam College
? Rasi College
And many more educational institutions actively joined hands in making this initiative a grand success.
